resources.string: Converts text or a book into Uzbek audio (MP3). Choose a file or paste text. The work continues in the background, even if you close the app. Scanned (image-based) PDF books are accepted too: they are first turned into text with Gemini (OCR).
Choose a file (TXT, PDF, EPUB, DOCX, FB2, HTML, ODT)
Convert the pasted text to audio
Select a job and double-tap — the actions menu opens (resume, save, share, remaining text).
No API key entered. Enter at least one Gemini API key in “Settings”.
First enter at least one Gemini API key in Settings. Open Settings?
“%1$s” and its audio file will be deleted. Save the audio first. Delete it?
The part that is not yet voiced is ready as TXT (Actions → Remaining text).
The text recognized so far is ready as TXT (Actions → OCR text).
Save the remaining text that is not voiced (TXT)
No app found to open the audio. Save it first.
Save the log as a TXT file
The log does not contain API keys (they are masked). To send it to the developer, tap “Share the log”.
Could not prepare the log file.
The latest part of the log was copied.
Test entries added — the log works.
All log entries will be deleted. Continue?
Important: if you add several keys, create them in different Google projects (or accounts) — the limit is counted per project, not per key. Keys are stored only on this device.
Backup model (used when the main model’s limit runs out; empty = off)
Chunk size (characters, 800–6000). A larger chunk means fewer requests but a higher chance of errors
Reading style (optional; if left empty the text is read exactly as written, nothing is added)
Battery saver settings (so the work is not interrupted in the background)
Enter at least one API key first.
No voices made specifically for Uzbek were found. Use the standard voices (they can read Uzbek text).
%1$d Uzbek voices loaded (marked with ★ at the top of the list).
Could not paste from the clipboard.
Enter at least one key to check.
Key %1$d: works. TTS models: %2$s. OCR (image reading) models: %3$s

Pages of image-based (scanned) PDFs are turned into text with Gemini Vision. Pages are sent in groups (4 by default); pages that already have digital text are not sent, which saves your limit. The page images are sent to Google’s servers.
Read scanned PDF pages with AI (OCR)
OCR model (a Gemini model that reads images)
OCR backup model (used when the main one’s limit runs out; empty = off)
Could not start the background service (%1$s). Open the app and tap “Resume”.
The original file was not found. Choose the file again.
Could not save the text (is there enough storage?): %1$s
The previous audio file was not found; only the new part will be written.
Could not read the text file: %1$s
No API key entered. Enter at least one key in Settings.
One part could not be voiced and was skipped.
Three parts in a row could not be voiced — there may be a problem with the service or the text. Check the error log, then tap “Resume”.
No working TTS model was found. Check the model name in Settings.
No internet — waiting for a connection…
Waiting for the limit: about %1$d seconds…
Google Gemini API does not work in this location (%1$s). A different network or a paid plan may be required.
The network error kept repeating (%1$s). Check your internet connection and tap “Resume”.
The MP3 encoder failed — the audio is being saved as WAV.
MP3 encoding failed (%1$s). See the log.
Could not write to the audio file: %1$s
Everything has been voiced. Skipped parts: %1$d (they can be exported as TXT).
The audio is ready (%1$s). Open the app to save it.
The audio is ready (%1$s). Open the app to save it. Skipped parts: %2$d (they can be exported as TXT).
The RTF format is not supported yet. Convert the file to DOCX or TXT and send it again.
The old DOC format is not supported. Convert the file to DOCX or TXT and send it again.
The MOBI/AZW format is not supported. Convert the file to EPUB or TXT and send it again.
No familiar format was found inside the ZIP archive. Unpack it and send the file inside.
No readable text was found in the file.
The file is not text (it is a binary file) — not supported.
The PDF is password-protected — send a copy without a password.
Could not open the PDF file: %1$s
No pages were found in the PDF.
No text was found in the PDF. It is a scanned (image-based) PDF. To read it, “Read scanned PDF pages with AI (OCR)” must be turned on in Settings.
No text was found on any page: the AI (OCR) could not extract any either. The pages may be blank or unreadable. See the error log.
Warning: the PDF text looks corrupted (a font encoding problem). Listen to the beginning to check it.
Warning: %1$d pages of the PDF could not be read.
The EPUB structure is invalid (container.xml is missing).
The EPUB structure is invalid (the OPF path was not found).
The EPUB structure is invalid (the OPF file is missing).
The reading order (spine) was not found inside the EPUB.
No text (word/document.xml) was found inside the DOCX.
content.xml was not found inside the ODT.
No FB2 file was found inside the archive.
[page %1$d] could not be read with AI (OCR). Reason: %2$s
AI OCR in progress: pages %1$d–%2$d of %3$d…
AI OCR in progress: page %1$d of %2$d…
%1$s OCR: %2$d of %3$d scanned pages are read and saved. Tap “Resume” and the rest continues from here.
No working model for reading images (OCR) was found. Check the OCR model in Settings.
Could not turn the PDF pages into images: %1$s
Warning: %1$d pages could not be read (pages: %2$s). They are not included in the text.
Three pages in a row could not be read — there may be a problem with the service or the document. Check the error log, then tap “Resume”.
The AI server is busy (HTTP %1$d): the main and backup models did not respond after several attempts. This does not mean the pages have no text.
The AI (OCR) could not read any page (server, network, limit or another error; the reason is in the error log). This does not mean the pages have no text.
The AI (OCR) could not read these pages: %1$s. This does not mean they have no text — see the error log and try again later.
Voicing is no longer possible with the available keys.
Reading pages (OCR) is no longer possible with the available keys.
The daily limit resets at midnight Pacific time (Los Angeles) — at about %1$s on your device’s clock.
The audio made so far has been saved; the remaining text is ready as TXT.
